title: Minimum Number of Visited Cells in a Grid
summary: Starting at the top-left cell, a jump from (i, j) can go right to (i, k) for j < k <= j + grid[i][j], or down to (k, j) for i < k <= i + grid[i][j]. Return the fewest cells visited to reach the bottom-right cell, or -1.
officialConstraints: Up to 10^5 cells in total; bottom-right cell is 0 (from search summary). Visualization cap: 8 rows and 8 columns, values 0..99.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps are listed in constraints; the DP table is shown in an 8 by 8 window that follows playback.
examplesNotes: Sources report the three expected outputs 4, 3 and -1. The grid inputs used here were not retrieved from a source; they were checked by brute force and match those outputs.
